paragraphs: Aira runs a service that connects people who are blind or low-vision to professional visual interpreters for access to visual information. Remote video interpreting supports greater independence and communication for both the blind and low-vision community and the Deaf and hard-of-hearing community.

In the Explorer app, interpreters convey visual information verbally so that tasks become easier to accomplish. A second app, Aira ASL, connects a user to a professional ASL interpreter over live video with the option of real-time captioning. Explorer can be used at no cost at thousands of Access Partner locations worldwide. The ASL app is free at select Access Partner locations throughout North America.

Organizations that value accessibility partner with Aira to offer the service at no cost to their employees, students, or customers. Those partnerships cover accommodations for employees, Access programs for customers, and accessibility for digital and physical spaces. The company employs its own team of visual interpreters and recruits for those roles. A banner notes recognition on the Forbes Accessibility 200 List.

quote.text: Our mission is to remove barriers and make the world more accessible.
